sign_convention: observed residual is magnetar_model - data; each node.model is the predicted residual -dm, so a correct chirp overlays the data

grid.source: prior: fit_residuals_free_magnetar FREE_MAGNETAR_BOUNDS (B14 0.1-5.0, T_ms 1.0-15.0). These are the priors used when B and P_spin vary in the residual chirp, the same forward path the demo evaluates. The joint-fit MOSFiT prior is wider still but is a prior on the continuum; the joint posterior is Bfield ~ 1.35 ± 0.014, Pspin ~ 4.73 ± 0.05 and is too tight for a demo slider.
